3.title: Fed policymakers at odds over causes of high inflation
3.summary: US inflation is expected to increase again in October, with potential implications for Federal Reserve interest rate decisions. Economists predict the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index to reach 3.8% this month. Analysts are divided regarding whether inflation is caused by demand or supply shocks stemming from recent policies. Market forecasts suggest three more rate hikes, signaling ongoing concerns about rising prices.

36.title: U.S. Rig Count Holds Steady as Oil Production Hits Fifth Straight Record
36.summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States stayed the same this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Wednesday ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The total rig count in the US remains at 607, up 63 from this same time last year. The number of active oil rigs rose by 1 to 470 during the latest reporting period, according to the data.
